package answer

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type assessmentQuestionEvaluation struct {
	correct          bool
	validationError  *ValidationError
	item             map[string]any
	selectedVariants []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant
}

func evaluateStructuredAssessment(answerID, taskID string, task *TaskMetadata, payload json.RawMessage) (*ValidationResult, map[string]any, []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, error) {
	if task == nil || len(task.Tests) == 0 {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid: false,
			Errors: []ValidationError{
				{Code: "TEST_DEFINITION_MISSING", Message: "Test questions are not configured"},
			},
		}, nil, nil, nil
	}

	body, err := decodeTaskTestAnswerPayload(task, payload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}

	submissionsByTestID := make(map[string]taskTestAnswerPayloadItem, len(body.Answers))
	for _, item := range body.Answers {
		submissionsByTestID[item.TestID] = item
	}

	selectedVariants := make([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, 0)
	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(task.Tests))
	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0)
	correctCount := 0
	incorrectCount := 0
	mode := ""
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	for _, test := range task.Tests {
		testID := strings.TrimSpace(test.ID)
		submission, exists := submissionsByTestID[testID]
		if !exists {
			return nil, nil, nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}

		kind := assessmentKindForTest(task, test)
		if mode == "" {
			mode = kind
		} else if mode != kind {
			mode = "mixed"
		}

		var evaluation assessmentQuestionEvaluation
		switch kind {
		case assessmentKindSingleChoice:
			evaluation, err = evaluateSingleChoiceQuestion(answerID, taskID, test, submission, now)
		case assessmentKindOrdering:
			evaluation, err = evaluateOrderingQuestion(answerID, taskID, test, submission, now)
		case assessmentKindClassification:
			evaluation, err = evaluateClassificationQuestion(answerID, taskID, test, submission, now)
		default:
			return nil, nil, nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}

		selectedVariants = append(selectedVariants, evaluation.selectedVariants...)
		items = append(items, evaluation.item)
		if evaluation.correct {
			correctCount++
			continue
		}
		incorrectCount++
		if evaluation.validationError != nil {
			errors = append(errors, *evaluation.validationError)
		}
	}

	passed := incorrectCount <= task.AllowedErrorsCount
	if !passed {
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    "TEST_ALLOWED_ERRORS_EXCEEDED",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Too many incorrect answers: %d (allowed %d)", incorrectCount, task.AllowedErrorsCount),
		})
	}

	result := &ValidationResult{Valid: passed, Errors: errors}
	rawResult := map[string]any{
		"source":               "task_test",
		"mode":                 mode,
		"total_questions":      len(task.Tests),
		"correct_answers":      correctCount,
		"incorrect_answers":    incorrectCount,
		"allowed_errors_count": task.AllowedErrorsCount,
		"errors":               errors,
		"items":                items,
	}
	return result, rawResult, selectedVariants, nil
}

// EvaluateDiagnosticStructuredAssessment is a pure placement scorer facade.
// It neither creates a StudentTaskAnswer nor persists variants, reviews,
// learning actions, progression, evidence, mastery, or events.
func EvaluateDiagnosticStructuredAssessment(task *TaskMetadata, payload json.RawMessage) (bool, error) {
	result, _, _, err := evaluateStructuredAssessment("diagnostic", "diagnostic", task, payload)
	if err != nil || result == nil {
		if err == nil {
			err = domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return false, err
	}
	return result.Valid, nil
}

func evaluateSingleChoiceQuestion(answerID, taskID string, test TaskTestMetadata, submission taskTestAnswerPayloadItem, now time.Time) (assessmentQuestionEvaluation, error) {
	var (
		selectedVariant *TaskTestVariantMetadata
		correctVariant  *TaskTestVariantMetadata
	)
	for index := range test.Variants {
		variant := &test.Variants[index]
		if strings.TrimSpace(variant.ID) == submission.VariantID {
			selectedVariant = variant
		}
		if variant.IsCorrect {
			correctVariant = variant
		}
	}
	if selectedVariant == nil || correctVariant == nil {
		return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	isCorrect := strings.TrimSpace(selectedVariant.ID) == strings.TrimSpace(correctVariant.ID)
	evaluation := assessmentQuestionEvaluation{
		correct: isCorrect,
		item: map[string]any{
			"test_id":               strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			"title":                 test.Title,
			"description":           test.Description,
			"selected_variant_id":   strings.TrimSpace(selectedVariant.ID),
			"selected_variant_text": selectedVariant.Text,
			"correct_variant_id":    safeTaskVariantID(correctVariant),
			"correct_variant_text":  safeTaskVariantText(correctVariant),
			"correct":               isCorrect,
		},
		selectedVariants: []domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{{
			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
			StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
			TaskID:              taskID,
			TaskTestID:          strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			TaskTestVariantID:   strings.TrimSpace(selectedVariant.ID),
			IsCorrect:           isCorrect,
			CreatedAt:           now,
		}},
	}
	if !isCorrect {
		evaluation.validationError = &ValidationError{
			Code:    "TEST_VARIANT_INCORRECT",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Incorrect answer for question: %s", test.Title),
		}
	}
	return evaluation, nil
}

func evaluateOrderingQuestion(answerID, taskID string, test TaskTestMetadata, submission taskTestAnswerPayloadItem, now time.Time) (assessmentQuestionEvaluation, error) {
	variantsByID := make(map[string]TaskTestVariantMetadata, len(test.Variants))
	correctPositions := make(map[string]int, len(test.Variants))
	seenPositions := make(map[int]struct{}, len(test.Variants))
	for _, variant := range test.Variants {
		variantID := strings.TrimSpace(variant.ID)
		if variantID == "" || variant.CorrectOrder == nil || *variant.CorrectOrder < 1 || *variant.CorrectOrder > len(test.Variants) {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := variantsByID[variantID]; duplicate {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenPositions[*variant.CorrectOrder]; duplicate {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		variantsByID[variantID] = variant
		correctPositions[variantID] = *variant.CorrectOrder
		seenPositions[*variant.CorrectOrder] = struct{}{}
	}

	questionCorrect := true
	selectedVariants := make([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, 0, len(submission.OrderedVariantIDs))
	for index, variantID := range submission.OrderedVariantIDs {
		variantID = strings.TrimSpace(variantID)
		if _, exists := variantsByID[variantID]; !exists {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		submittedOrder := index + 1
		positionCorrect := correctPositions[variantID] == submittedOrder
		if !positionCorrect {
			questionCorrect = false
		}
		selectedVariants = append(selectedVariants, domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
			StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
			TaskID:              taskID,
			TaskTestID:          strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			TaskTestVariantID:   variantID,
			SubmittedOrder:      &submittedOrder,
			IsCorrect:           positionCorrect,
			CreatedAt:           now,
		})
	}

	evaluation := assessmentQuestionEvaluation{
		correct: questionCorrect,
		item: map[string]any{
			"test_id":               strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			"title":                 test.Title,
			"description":           test.Description,
			"submitted_variant_ids": append([]string(nil), submission.OrderedVariantIDs...),
			"correct":               questionCorrect,
		},
		selectedVariants: selectedVariants,
	}
	if !questionCorrect {
		evaluation.validationError = &ValidationError{
			Code:    "TEST_ORDER_INCORRECT",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Incorrect order for question: %s", test.Title),
		}
	}
	return evaluation, nil
}

func evaluateClassificationQuestion(answerID, taskID string, test TaskTestMetadata, submission taskTestAnswerPayloadItem, now time.Time) (assessmentQuestionEvaluation, error) {
	groupsByID := make(map[string]struct{}, len(test.Groups))
	for _, group := range test.Groups {
		groupID := strings.TrimSpace(group.ID)
		if groupID == "" {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := groupsByID[groupID]; duplicate {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		groupsByID[groupID] = struct{}{}
	}

	trustedGroupsByVariantID := make(map[string]string, len(test.Variants))
	usedGroups := make(map[string]struct{}, len(test.Groups))
	for _, variant := range test.Variants {
		variantID := strings.TrimSpace(variant.ID)
		groupID := strings.TrimSpace(variant.GroupID)
		if variantID == "" || groupID == "" || variant.IsCorrect || variant.CorrectOrder != nil {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := trustedGroupsByVariantID[variantID]; duplicate {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := groupsByID[groupID]; !exists {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		trustedGroupsByVariantID[variantID] = groupID
		usedGroups[groupID] = struct{}{}
	}
	if len(usedGroups) != len(groupsByID) {
		return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	questionCorrect := true
	selectedVariants := make([]domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant, 0, len(submission.GroupAssignments))
	for _, assignment := range submission.GroupAssignments {
		variantID := strings.TrimSpace(assignment.VariantID)
		submittedGroupID := strings.TrimSpace(assignment.GroupID)
		trustedGroupID, exists := trustedGroupsByVariantID[variantID]
		if !exists {
			return assessmentQuestionEvaluation{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		assignmentCorrect := submittedGroupID == trustedGroupID
		if !assignmentCorrect {
			questionCorrect = false
		}
		selectedVariants = append(selectedVariants, domain.TaskTestAnswerVariant{
			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
			StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
			TaskID:              taskID,
			TaskTestID:          strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			TaskTestVariantID:   variantID,
			SubmittedGroupID:    &submittedGroupID,
			IsCorrect:           assignmentCorrect,
			CreatedAt:           now,
		})
	}

	evaluation := assessmentQuestionEvaluation{
		correct: questionCorrect,
		item: map[string]any{
			"test_id":                     strings.TrimSpace(test.ID),
			"title":                       test.Title,
			"description":                 test.Description,
			"submitted_group_assignments": append([]taskTestGroupAssignmentPayload(nil), submission.GroupAssignments...),
			"correct":                     questionCorrect,
		},
		selectedVariants: selectedVariants,
	}
	if !questionCorrect {
		evaluation.validationError = &ValidationError{
			Code:    "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_INCORRECT",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Incorrect classification for question: %s", test.Title),
		}
	}
	return evaluation, nil
}
